connectors.name: AniKoto
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.13: follows the source's move to anikototv.bz. Adds the new address to the allowed hosts and accepts saved title links from either address. Routes, title matching and audio handling are unchanged from 0.3.12. Measured on 14 Nov 2026 at 36 of 47 available titles (middle episode); spoken language and device playback were not verified.

connectors.name: AniPM (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Playback proceeds only when AniPM declares the requested Sub or Dub availability and matching effective language for the episode. Missing or conflicting declarations fail before session creation. Existing saved titles, episode mapping, request headers, supplied captions, and session-expiry handling are preserved. Requires Aroki 2.1.36 or newer.

connectors.name: Synthetiq Flux
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.6 adds genres, year and status to Home, Browse and search cards so Find a niche can filter this source. Title identity, episode, Sub/Dub and playback routes are unchanged from 0.1.5. Measured on 15 Nov 2026 on a Mac test run: 49 of 50 sampled titles reached playable video. The Niche screen and spoken language were not checked on a device. Requires Aroki 2.1.36 or newer.
